import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files[0], index_col=0)
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files[1], index_col=0)

    # Both sources have the exact same schema as the target schema.
    # According to hints:
    # - Since schemas are identical, UNION (concat) is preferred.
    # - We must use all source tables.
    # - The target schema columns and types must be preserved.
    # - No aggregation or join needed because schemas match exactly.
    # - Just concatenate and ensure dtypes match target schema.

    # Define target schema dtypes explicitly for enforcement
    target_dtypes = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # nullable integer
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',    # nullable integer
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',            # nullable integer
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',        # nullable integer
        'gender': 'Int64'             # nullable integer
    }

    # Convert columns to target dtypes for both dataframes
    for col, dtype in target_dtypes.items():
        if col in df0.columns:
            # For string columns, convert to pandas string dtype
            if dtype == 'string':
                df0[col] = df0[col].astype('string')
                df1[col] = df1[col].astype('string')
            else:
                # For nullable integers, use pandas nullable Int64 dtype
                if dtype == 'Int64':
                    df0[col] = pd.to_numeric(df0[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
                    df1[col] = pd.to_numeric(df1[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
                else:
                    df0[col] = pd.to_numeric(df0[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)
                    df1[col] = pd.to_numeric(df1[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)

    # Concatenate the two dataframes (union)
    df_target = pd.concat([df0, df1], ignore_index=True)

    # After concat, ensure the dtypes again (sometimes concat can upcast)
    for col, dtype in target_dtypes.items():
        if dtype == 'string':
            df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype('string')
        elif dtype == 'Int64':
            df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        else:
            df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)

    # Final check: reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df_target = df_target[list(target_dtypes.keys())]

    # Write the result to the target CSV file without the index column
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
